" alt="真实月面照片"></div>

  <aside class="side pn">

<script>
const SEC=[
 {id:'home',n:'首页',en:'HOME'},
 {id:'msg',n:'留言板',en:'MESSAGES',ph:'想对未来说的话……',nt:1,nc:1,bl:'留言',x:[{k:'who',l:'署名'}]},
 {id:'world',n:'世界观索引',en:'WORLD',tl:'世界观名称',nc:1,ph:'这个世界观的设定……',bl:'世界观设定',x:[{k:'pg',l:'进度',o:['已完成','计划写','构思中','待写','灵感','待发展'],nb:1},{k:'sum',l:'简介',a:1}]},
 {id:'char',n:'角色档案',en:'PEOPLE',tl:'标题（可选，如：杀手线）',nc:1,ph:'这个角色在该世界观里的设定……',bl:'设定',x:[{k:'ch',l:'角色',o:['林椿','卡卡西'],nb:1},{k:'wid',l:'所属世界观',w:1},{k:'role',l:'身份'},{k:'age',l:'年龄'},{k:'exp',l:'经历',a:1}]},
 {id:'lore',n:'设定资料库',en:'ARCHIVE',tl:'资料标题',ph:'地点、规则、势力、名词……',bl:'资料内容',x:[{k:'wid',l:'所属世界观',w:1}]},
 {id:'draft',n:'文稿存档',en:'MANUSCRIPT'},
 {id:'fav',n:'收藏管理',en:'FAVORITES',ph:'摘抄、感想……',x:[{k:'url',l:'链接'},{k:'star',l:'评分',o:['★','★★','★★★','★★★★','★★★★★']}]},
 {id:'tarot',n:'塔罗存档',en:'TAROT',nc:1,ph:'牌面与解读，或传讯的对话……',bl:'牌面与解读 / 对话内容',x:[{k:'sp',l:'类型',o:['抽牌提问','传讯对话'],nb:1},{k:'qu',l:'所问的问题'}]},
 {id:'idea',n:'灵感笔记',en:'IDEAS',ph:'一瞬间的念头……',x:[{k:'col',l:'便签颜色',o:['蓝','白','浅蓝','黄']}]},
 {id:'time',n:'时间线',en:'TIMELINE',ph:'发生了什么……',x:[{k:'tl',l:'所属时间线',tl:1},{k:'when',l:'时间点（可写自定义纪年）'},{k:'ord',l:'排序数字（小的在前）'}]}
];
const TAR='愚者 魔术师 女祭司 皇后 皇帝 教皇 恋人 战车 力量 隐者 命运之轮 正义 倒吊人 死神 节制 恶魔 塔 星星 月亮 太阳 审判 世界'.split(' ');
const ROM='0 I II III IV V VI VII VIII IX X XI XII XIII XIV XV XVI XVII XVIII XIX XX XXI'.split(' ');
let DB={};try{DB=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('mingyue')||'{}')}catch(e){}
const mig=()=>{DB._v=DB._v||{};DB._todo=DB._todo||[];DB._ph=DB._ph||{};if(DB._cv){DB._ph.cover=DB._cv;delete DB._cv}if(DB._av){DB._ph.av=DB._av;delete DB._av}DB._tls=DB._tls&&DB._tls.length?DB._tls:[{id:'def',n:'时间线'}];DB._mp=DB._mp||{list:[],idx:0,vol:.8,mode:0,st:'ball'};['msg','idea','world','char','lore','draft','fav','tarot','time'].forEach(k=>DB[k]=DB[k]||[])};mig();
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('mingyue',JSON.stringify(DB))}catch(e){alert('保存失败：存储空间不足，请先导出备份')}};
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const esc=s=>String(s||'').replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
const today=()=>new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10);
const snap=v=>Math.round(v/12)*12;
let cur='home',q='',cat='';

/* ---------- camellia symbol ---------- */
(function(){
 let s='<g stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linejoin="round">';
 [[26,19,25,0,'var(--cf,#fff)'],[31,15,20,36,'var(--cg,#f3f6ff)'],[37,10,14,0,'var(--cf,#fff)'],[41,6,9,36,'var(--cg,#dfe7ff)']].forEach(([cy,rx,ry,o,f])=>{
  for(let k=0;k<5;k++)s+=`<ellipse cx="50" cy="${cy}" rx="${rx}" ry="${ry}" transform="rotate(${o+k*72} 50 50)" fill="${f}"/>`});
 s+='</g><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="5" fill="#fbe98a"/>';
 for(let k=0;k<8;k++){const a=k*Math.PI/4;s+=`<circle cx="${50+10*Math.cos(a)}" cy="${50+10*Math.sin(a)}" r="1.8" fill="#f3d85a"/>`}
 document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',`<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute"><symbol id="cam" viewBox="0 0 100 100">${s}</symbol></svg>`);
})();
const cam=(c='',st='')=>`<svg class="cam ${c}" style="${st}" viewBox="0 0 100 100"><use href="#cam"/></svg>`;
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const c=e.target.closest('svg.cam');if(c){c.classList.remove('bloom');void c.getBoundingClientRect();c.classList.add('bloom')}});
// falling petals
for(let i=0;i<9;i++){const d=document.createElement('div');d.className='fall';const z=14+Math.random()*16;d.style.cssText=`left:${Math.random()*100}%;font-size:${z}px;animation-duration:${18+Math.random()*16}s;animation-delay:${-Math.random()*30}s`;d.innerHTML=cam('','pointer-events:none');document.body.appendChild(d)}

/* ---------- splash ---------- */
(function(){
 const c=$('#stars'),x=c.getContext('2d');let W,H,st=[],run=true;
 function rs(){W=c.width=innerWidth;H=c.height=innerHeight;st=Array.from({length:110},()=>({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,r:Math.random()*1.6+.3,p:Math.random()*6.28,s:.5+Math.random()*1.5}))}
 rs();addEventListener('resize',rs);
 (function f(t){if(!run)return;x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);st.forEach(s=>{const a=.35+.65*Math.abs(Math.sin(t/1000*s.s+s.p));x.globalAlpha=a;x.fillStyle='#fff';x.beginPath();x.arc(s.x,s.y,s.r,0,6.28);x.fill();if(s.r>1.05){const l=s.r>1.4?9:5;x.save();x.translate(s.x,s.y);x.globalAlpha=a*.88;x.fillStyle='#fff';x.shadowColor='#f7fbff';x.shadowBlur=8;x.beginPath();x.moveTo(0,-l);x.quadraticCurveTo(.7,-.7,l,0);x.quadraticCurveTo(.7,.7,0,l);x.quadraticCurveTo(-.7,.7,-l,0);x.quadraticCurveTo(-.7,-.7,0,-l);x.fill();x.restore()}});requestAnimationFrame(f)})(0);
 let p=0;const arc=$('#arc');
 const iv=setInterval(()=>{p+=1+Math.random()*3;if(p>=100){p=100;clearInterval(iv);$('#ld').style.opacity=$('#lt').style.opacity=0;setTimeout(()=>{$('#ld').style.display=$('#lt').style.display='none';$('#enter').style.display='block'},500)}
  arc.style.strokeDashoffset=553*(1-p/100);$('#pc').textContent=Math.floor(p)},90);
 $('#enter').onclick=()=>{const s=$('#splash');s.style.opacity=0;setTimeout(()=>{s.remove();run=false},1000)};
})();

/* ---------- helpers ---------- */
function shrink(f,max,cb){const r=new FileReader();r.onload=()=>{const im=new Image();im.onload=()=>{const k=Math.min(1,max/Math.max(im.width,im.height)),c=document.createElement('canvas');c.width=im.width*k;c.height=im.height*k;c.getContext('2d').drawImage(im,0,0,c.width,c.height);cb(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.8))};im.src=r.result};r.readAsDataURL(f)}
function fit(b){let m=0;[...b.children].forEach(c=>{if(c.tagName!=='CANVAS')m=Math.max(m,c.offsetTop+c.offsetHeight)});b.style.height=Math.max(m+90,innerHeight*.5)+'px'}
function drag(el,end,click){
 el.onpointerdown=ev=>{
  if(ev.button>0||ev.target.closest('button'))return;
  const b=el.parentElement,sx=ev.clientX,sy=ev.clientY,ox=el.offsetLeft,oy=el.offsetTop;let mv=0;
  el.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId);el.classList.add('drag');
  el.onpointermove=e=>{const dx=e.clientX-sx,dy=e.clientY-sy;if(Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)>5)mv=1;if(!mv)return;
   el.style.left=Math.max(0,Math.min(b.clientWidth-el.offsetWidth,snap(ox+dx)))+'px';
   el.style.top=Math.max(0,snap(oy+dy))+'px';fit(b)};
  const up=()=>{el.onpointermove=el.onpointerup=el.onpointercancel=null;el.classList.remove('drag');if(mv){end&&end(el.offsetLeft,el.offsetTop)}else click&&click()};
  el.onpointerup=el.onpointercancel=up;
 };
}

/* ---------- camellia dot field (hero + every board) ---------- */
function dotField(host,alpha){
 const cv=document.createElement('canvas');cv.className='df';host.prepend(cv);
 const x=cv.getContext('2d'),dpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);let P=[],W=0,H=0,mx=-999,my=-999;
 function build(){
  P=[];const D=Math.min(W*.92,520),R=D/2,g=D>300?7:6,cx=W/2,cy=Math.min(H/2,R+8);
  for(let i=cx-R;i<cx+R;i+=g)for(let j=cy-R;j<cy+R;j+=g){
   const dx=i-cx,dy=j-cy,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),an=Math.atan2(dy,dx),f=Math.abs(Math.cos(2.5*an)),lim=R*(.55+.45*f);
   if(d<lim&&d>R*.12){const ring=Math.abs(Math.sin(d/R*9+f*2));P.push({hx:i,hy:j,x:i,y:j,vx:0,vy:0,r:(d>lim-g?.8:(ring>.55?1.9:1.1))*(g/6)})}
  }
 }
 function size(){const w=host.clientWidth,h=host.clientHeight;cv.width=w*dpr;cv.height=h*dpr;x.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);H=h;if(w!==W){W=w;build()}}
 size();
 const ro=new ResizeObserver(size);ro.observe(host);
 const mv=e=>{const r=cv.getBoundingClientRect();mx=e.clientX-r.left;my=e.clientY-r.top};
 addEventListener('pointermove',mv);
 (function f(){
  if(!cv.isConnected){removeEventListener('pointermove',mv);ro.disconnect();return}
  x.clearRect(0,0,W,H);x.fillStyle=`rgba(45,68,216,${alpha})`;
  for(const p of P){
   const dx=p.x-mx,dy=p.y-my,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
   if(d<70&&d>0){const k=(70-d)/70*6;p.vx+=dx/d*k;p.vy+=dy/d*k}
   p.vx+=(p.hx-p.x)*.06;p.vy+=(p.hy-p.y)*.06;p.vx*=.82;p.vy*=.82;p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;
   x.beginPath();x.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,6.28);x.fill();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(f);
 })();
}

/* ---------- moon phase ---------- */
const age=()=>(((Date.now()-Date.UTC(2000,0,6,18,14))/864e5)%29.530588+29.530588)%29.530588;
function moonSVG(f){
 const k=Math.cos(2*Math.PI*f),rx=40*Math.abs(k),wax=f<.5,sw=wax?(k>0?0:1):(k>0?1:0);
 return `<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" class="moon"><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40" fill="#1a2780"/><path d="M50 10A40 40 0 0 ${wax?1:0} 50 90A${rx} 40 0 0 ${sw} 50 10Z" fill="#fffbe6"/><circle cx="50" cy="50" r="40" fill="none" stroke="#2d44d8" stroke-width="2"/></svg>`;
}
function widgets(){
 const a=age(),f=a/29.530588,nm=f<.03||f>.97?'新月':f<.22?'娥眉月':f<.28?'上弦月':f<.47?'盈凸月':f<.53?'满月':f<.72?'亏凸月':f<.78?'下弦月':'残月';
 $('#mo').innerHTML=moonSVG(f)+`<div class="c"><b>${nm}</b><br>月龄 ${a.toFixed(1)} 日</div>`;
 const d=new Date();$('#wk').textContent=d.toLocaleDateString('zh-CN',{weekday:'long'});
 $('#td').innerHTML=`<div class="big">${d.getDate()}<small>${d.toLocaleString('en',{month:'short'}).toUpperCase()}</small></div><div id="wx"></div>`;
 todo();wxRender();wxFetch();
}
/* ---------- snowflake-camellia button symbol ---------- */
(function(){
 let w='<g stroke="#8fb0e8" stroke-width="3.2" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">';
 for(let k=0;k<6;k++)w+=`<g transform="rotate(${k*60} 50 50)"><path d="M50 50V9M50 19L43 12M50 19L57 12M50 30L45 25M50 30L55 25"/><circle cx="50" cy="8" r="2.2" fill="#8fb0e8"/></g>`;
 w+='</g>';
 document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin',`<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute"><symbol id="snow" viewBox="0 0 100 100">${w}</symbol></svg>`);
})();

/* ---------- floating todo window ---------- */
function todo(){
 $('#tl').innerHTML=DB._todo.length?DB._todo.map((t,i)=>`<div class="${t.d?'dn':''}"><input type="checkbox" data-k="${i}" ${t.d?'checked':''}><span class="t">${esc(t.t)}</span><x data-x="${i}">✕</x></div>`).join(''):'<div style="opacity:.5">暂时没有待办 ✿</div>';
 $('#tcn').textContent=DB._todo.filter(t=>!t.d).length||'';
}
$('#tl').onclick=e=>{const k=e.target.dataset.k,x=e.target.dataset.x;if(k!=null)DB._todo[k].d=e.target.checked;else if(x!=null)DB._todo.splice(x,1);else return;save();todo()};
const addTodo=()=>{const v=$('#ti').value.trim();if(!v)return;DB._todo.push({t:v,d:0});$('#ti').value='';save();todo()};
$('#tb2').onclick=addTodo;$('#ti').onkeydown=e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')addTodo()};
function fdrag(el,hd,onTap,key='_tp'){
 hd.addEventListener('pointerdown',ev=>{
  if(ev.target.closest('button,input'))return;
  const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),sx=ev.clientX,sy=ev.clientY;let mv=0;
  hd.setPointerCapture(ev.pointerId);
  const m=e=>{const dx=e.clientX-sx,dy=e.clientY-sy;if(Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)>5)mv=1;if(!mv)return;
   el.style.left=Math.max(0,Math.min(innerWidth-el.offsetWidth,r.left+dx))+'px';el.style.top=Math.max(0,Math.min(innerHeight-el.offsetHeight,r.top+dy))+'px';el.style.right=el.style.bottom='auto'};
  const u=()=>{hd.removeEventListener('pointermove',m);hd.removeEventListener('pointerup',u);hd.removeEventListener('pointercancel',u);
   if(mv){DB[key]={x:el.offsetLeft,y:el.offsetTop};save()}else if(onTap)onTap()};
  hd.addEventListener('pointermove',m);hd.addEventListener('pointerup',u);hd.addEventListener('pointercancel',u);
 });
}
(function(){
 const w=$('#tdw');
 const setMin=m=>{w.classList.toggle('min',m);DB._tm=m;save();if(w.style.left){w.style.left=Math.max(0,Math.min(w.offsetLeft,innerWidth-w.offsetWidth))+'px';w.style.top=Math.max(0,Math.min(w.offsetTop,innerHeight-w.offsetHeight))+'px'}};
 if(DB._tm)w.classList.add('min');
 if(DB._tp){w.style.left=Math.max(0,Math.min(DB._tp.x,innerWidth-60))+'px';w.style.top=Math.max(0,Math.min(DB._tp.y,innerHeight-60))+'px';w.style.right=w.style.bottom='auto'}
 fdrag(w,w.querySelector('.th'));
 fdrag(w,w.querySelector('.bub2'),()=>setMin(false));
 w.querySelector('[data-tm]').onclick=()=>setMin(true);
})();

/* ---------- photos (swap anywhere) ---------- */
const pbtn=k=>`<div class="pb"><button data-ph="${k}">换图</button>${DB._ph[k]?`<button data-rm="${k}">✕</button>`:''}</div>`;
const ph=(k,c)=>`<div class="ps ${c} ${DB._ph[k]?'has':''}">${DB._ph[k]?`<img src="${DB._ph[k]}">`:`<div class="pe">${cam('','pointer-events:none')}<span>添加照片</span></div>`}${pbtn(k)}</div>`;
const avatar=()=>{$('#av').innerHTML=DB._ph.av?`<img src="${DB._ph.av}">`:cam('','font-size:46px')};
const pn=()=>DB._pn==null?4:DB._pn;
const pkey=i=>i?'side'+(i+1):'side';
const side=()=>{const n=pn();$('#phw').innerHTML=`<div class="pg ${n==1?'one':''}">${Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>ph(pkey(i),'sq')).join('')}</div>`+(n?'':'<div class="note">点右上角 ＋ 添加相框</div>')};
const all=()=>{avatar();side();render()};
$('#pa').onclick=()=>{if(pn()<12){DB._pn=pn()+1;save();side()}};
$('#pr').onclick=()=>{const n=pn();if(!n)return;const k=pkey(n-1);if(DB._ph[k]&&!confirm('最后一个相框里有照片，确定移除？'))return;delete DB._ph[k];DB._pn=n-1;save();side()};
const fin=document.createElement('input');fin.type='file';fin.accept='image/*';fin.hidden=true;document.body.appendChild(fin);
let pk='';
function setPh(k,u){if(k.startsWith('e:')){const [,sc,id]=k.split(':'),en=(DB[sc]||[]).find(x=>x.id==id);if(en)en.img=u}else DB._ph[k]=u;save();all()}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
 const a=e.target.closest('[data-ph]'),r=e.target.closest('[data-rm]');
 if(r){delete DB._ph[r.dataset.rm];save();all()}
 else if(a){pk=a.dataset.ph;fin.value='';fin.click()}
});
fin.onchange=()=>{const f=fin.files[0];if(f&&pk)shrink(f,pk==='av'?300:900,u=>setPh(pk,u))};
$('#av').title='点击更换头像';

/* ---------- common ---------- */
const ZN=SEC.filter(z=>!['home','msg'].includes(z.id));
let wsel=null,lastNew=0;
const go=id=>{cur=id;q=cat='';render();scrollTo(0,0)};
const cnt=b=>(b||'').replace(/\s/g,'').length;
const byDate=a=>[...a].sort((x,y)=>(y.d||'').localeCompare(x.d||'')||y.id-x.id);
const hay=e=>esc([e.t,e.c,e.b,e.role,e.when,e.who,e.url,e.sum,e.exp,e.qu,e.ch].join(' ').toLowerCase());
const dat=(e,s,c=e.c)=>`data-s="${s}" data-i="${e.id}" data-h="${hay(e)}" data-c="${esc(c)}"`;
const empty=()=>`<div class="empty">${cam()}空空如也</div>`;
const safeUrl=u=>/^https?:\/\//i.test(u)?u:'https://'+u;
function af(){document.querySelectorAll('[data-h]').forEach(el=>{el.classList.toggle('dim',!((!cat||el.dataset.c===cat)&&(!q||el.dataset.h.includes(q.toLowerCase()))))})}

function cardHTML(e,s,i){
 const vi=s==='idea'&&e.col?Math.max(0,['蓝','白','浅蓝','黄'].indexOf(e.col)):e.id%3;
 return `<div class="card v${vi}" ${dat(e,s)} style="left:${e.x}px;top:${e.y}px;animation-delay:${-(i%7)}s">${vi%3?cam('cc','pointer-events:none'):''}<button class="cm" data-ph="e:${s}:${e.id}">换图</button>${e.img?`<div class="ph"><img src="${e.img}"></div>`:''}<div class="cb"><small>${esc(e.c||e.who||'—')} · ${esc(e.d)}</small>${e.t?`<h3>${esc(e.t)}</h3>`:''}<p style="--lc:${s==='msg'?6:3}">${esc(e.b)}</p></div></div>`;
}
function itemHTML(e,s){
 return `<div class="item" ${dat(e,s)}>${e.img?`<img src="${e.img}">`:cam('','font-size:34px;pointer-events:none')}<div><b>${esc(e.t)||'（无题）'}</b>${e.sp?`<span class="tag">${esc(e.sp)}</span>`:''}<small>${esc(e.c)} ${esc(e.d)}</small><p>${esc(e.b)}</p></div></div>`;
}
function boardHTML(sec){
 const l=DB[sec]=DB[sec]||[],es=byDate(l);
 const cw=innerWidth<560?162:192,W=Math.min($('#main').clientWidth||innerWidth,1000)-70,cols=Math.max(1,Math.floor(W/cw));
 let my=0,k=0,dirty=0;
 es.forEach(e=>{if(e.x!=null)my=Math.max(my,(e.y||0)+190)});
 es.forEach(e=>{if(e.x==null){e.x=snap((k%cols)*cw+12+Math.random()*10);e.y=snap(my+Math.floor(k/cols)*190+12+Math.random()*24);k++;dirty=1}});
 if(dirty)save();
 return `<div class="board" id="bd">${es.map((e,i)=>cardHTML(e,sec,i)).join('')}</div><div class="note">拖动卡片排列位置 · 点击打开编辑 · 双击空白处新建 · 点一点山茶花试试</div>`;
}
function bindBoard(sec){
 const bd=$('#bd');if(!bd)return;
 dotField(bd,.3);
 bd.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(el=>drag(el,(x,y)=>{const e=DB[sec].find(z=>z.id==el.dataset.i);e.x=x;e.y=y;save()},()=>edit(sec,+el.dataset.i)));
 for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const d=document.createElement('div'),z=[26,34,48,64][i%4];d.className='lc';d.style.cssText=`width:${z}px;height:${z}px;left:${snap(Math.random()*Math.max(60,bd.clientWidth-80))}px;top:${snap(Math.random()*300)}px;opacity:${.25+Math.random()*.3}`;d.innerHTML=cam();bd.appendChild(d);drag(d)}
 bd.ondblclick=e=>{if(e.target!==bd)return;const r=bd.getBoundingClientRect();edit(sec,null,{x:Math.max(0,snap(e.clientX-r.left-80)),y:Math.max(0,snap(e.clientY-r.top-20))})};
 fit(bd);
}

/* ---------- zone views ---------- */
const PG=['已完成','计划写','构思中','待写','灵感','待发展'];
const DCATS=['正文','片段','大纲','设定草稿','废稿回收','其他'];
const CHS=['林椿','卡卡西'];
let wf='',wopen=null,ctab='林椿',tlsel=null;
const W=()=>DB.world||[];
const wname=id=>id==='canon'?'原著世界观':((W().find(w=>String(w.id)===String(id))||{}).t||'');
const wlabel=k=>k===''?'未关联世界观':k==='canon'?'原著世界观':(wname(k)||'（已删除的世界观）');
const wfil=e=>!wf||(wf==='none'?!e.wid:String(e.wid||'')===wf);
const rwf=()=>wf&&wf!=='none'?wf:'';
const wopts=()=>[{v:'',l:'（不关联）'},{v:'canon',l:'原著世界观'},...W().map(w=>({v:String(w.id),l:w.t||'（无题）'}))];
const opt=(a,v)=>a.map(o=>`<option value="${esc(o.v)}" ${String(o.v)===String(v||'')?'selected':''}>${esc(o.l)}</option>`).join('');
const wfHTML=()=>`<select id="wf" class="sel"><option value="">全部世界观</option><option value="canon" ${wf==='canon'?'selected':''}>原著世界观</option>${W().map(w=>`<option value="${w.id}" ${String(w.id)===wf?'selected':''}>${esc(w.t)}</option>`).join('')}<option value="none" ${wf==='none'?'selected':''}>未关联</option></select>`;
const toolsH=(btns,useWf)=>`<div class="tools"><input id="q" placeholder="搜索 SEARCH…" value="${esc(q)}">${useWf?wfHTML():''}${btns}</div>`;
const chipsH=a=>`<div class="chips"><button class="chip ${cat?'':'on'}" data-c="">全部</button>${a.map(c=>`<button class="chip ${c===cat?'on':''}" data-c="${esc(c)}">${esc(c)}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
function byWorld(l){
 const g={};l.forEach(e=>{const k=String(e.wid||'');(g[k]=g[k]||[]).push(e)});
 const ord=['canon',...W().map(w=>String(w.id)),''];
 return [...ord.filter(k=>g[k]),...Object.keys(g).filter(k=>!ord.includes(k))].map(k=>[k,g[k]]);
}
const cntW=(k,id)=>(DB[k]||[]).filter(e=>String(e.wid)===String(id)).length;
const catsOf=l=>[...new Set(l.map(e=>e.c).filter(Boolean))];

/* rich text helpers */
const plain2html=t=>esc(t||'').split('\n').map(p=>`<p>${p||'<br>'}</p>`).join('');
function clean(h){const t=document.createElement('template');t.innerHTML=h||'';t.content.querySelectorAll('script,style,iframe,object,embed,link,meta,form').forEach(n=>n.remove());t.content.querySelectorAll('*').forEach(n=>[...n.attributes].forEach(a=>{if(/^on/i.test(a.name)||/^\s*javascript:/i.test(a.value))n.removeAttribute(a.name)}));return t.innerHTML}
const getH=e=>e.h?clean(e.h):plain2html(e.b);
const DOCCSS='body{font-family:"Songti SC","SimSun","Noto Serif SC",serif;font-size:12pt;line-height:1.9;color:#222;padding:0 8px}h1{font-size:20pt;text-align:center;margin:1.2em 0 .6em}h2{font-size:15pt;margin:1em 0 .4em}blockquote{margin:.8em 1.5em;padding-left:1em;border-left:3px solid #999;color:#555}p{margin:.4em 0}ul,ol{margin:.5em 0 .5em 1.5em}';
const docFull=(t,h)=>`<html xmlns:o="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:office" xmlns:w="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:office:word"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>${esc(t)||'文稿'}</title><style>${DOCCSS}</style></head><body><h1 style="font-size:22pt">${esc(t)}</h1>${h}</body></html>`;
function exWord(t,h){const a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob(['\ufeff'+docFull(t,h)],{type:'application/msword'}));a.download=(t||'文稿')+'.doc';a.click()}
function exPdf(t,h){const f=document.createElement('iframe');f.style.cssText='position:fixed;right:0;bottom:0;width:0;height:0;border:0';document.body.appendChild(f);const d=f.contentWindow.document;d.open();d.write(docFull(t,h));d.close();setTimeout(()=>{f.contentWindow.focus();f.contentWindow.print();setTimeout(()=>f.remove(),3000)},400)}

const Z={},B={};
/* world */
const worldCard=w=>`<div class="wcard" ${dat(w,'world')} data-wo="${w.id}">${w.img?`<img src="${w.img}">`:''}<div class="cb"><b>${esc(w.t)||'（未命名）'}</b><p>${esc(w.sum)}</p><small>角色 ${cntW('char',w.id)} · 设定 ${cntW('lore',w.id)} · 文稿 ${cntW('draft',w.id)} · 时间线 ${(DB._tls||[]).filter(t=>String(t.wid||'')===String(w.id)).length}</small></div></div>`;
function worldDetail(w){
 const id=String(w.id),f=k=>(DB[k]||[]).filter(e=>String(e.wid)===id);
 const lst=(a,attr,fn)=>a.length?a.map(e=>`<button class="lb" ${attr}="${e.id}">${fn(e)}</button>`).join(''):'<span class="ep2">— 暂无 —</span>';
 const tlw=(DB._tls||[]).filter(t=>String(t.wid||'')===id);
 return `<div class="tools"><button class="btn o" data-act="wback">← 世界观列表</button><button class="btn" data-act="wedit">编辑</button><select id="wpg" class="sel">${PG.map(p=>`<option ${p===(w.pg||'构思中')?'selected':''}>${p}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>
 <div class="wdt"><h3>${esc(w.t)||'（未命名）'}</h3>${w.img?`<img class="pre" src="${w.img}">`:''}
 <div class="wsum">简介</div><div class="wb">${esc(w.sum)||'<span class="ep2">—</span>'}</div>
 <div class="wsum">世界观设定</div><div class="wb">${esc(w.b)||'<span class="ep2">—</span>'}</div>
 <div class="wsum">角色档案 <button class="mini" data-act="addch" title="添加角色设定">＋</button> <button class="lb" data-act="gochar">去角色档案 →</button></div><div>${lst(f('char'),'data-ech',e=>esc(e.ch||'未分配')+(e.t?' · '+esc(e.t):''))}</div>
 <div class="wsum">设定资料 <button class="mini" data-act="addlo" title="添加设定资料">＋</button> <button class="lb" data-act="golore">去设定资料 →</button></div><div>${lst(f('lore'),'data-elo',e=>esc(e.t)||'（无题）')}</div>
 <div class="wsum">时间线 <button class="mini" data-act="addtl" title="新建时间线">＋</button> <button class="lb" data-act="gotl">去时间线 →</button></div><div>${tlw.length?tlw.map(t=>`<button class="lb" data-etl="${t.id}">${esc(t.n)}</button>`).join(''):'<span class="ep2">— 暂无 —</span>'}</div>
 <div class="wsum">文稿 <button class="mini" data-act="adddr" title="新建文稿">＋</button> <button class="lb" data-act="godraft">去文稿存档 →</button></div><div>${lst(f('draft'),'data-edr',e=>esc(e.t)||'（无题）')}</div></div>`;
}
Z.world=l=>{
 if(wopen!=null){const w=l.find(x=>x.id===wopen);if(w)return worldDetail(w);wopen=null}
 let h=toolsH('<button class="btn" id="n1">＋ 新建世界观</button>');
 if(!l.length)return h+empty()+'<div class="note">先建几个世界观，再给它们添加角色设定、设定资料和文稿</div>';
 PG.forEach(p=>{const a=byDate(l.filter(w=>(w.pg||'构思中')===p));h+=`<div class="pgh">${cam('','font-size:16px;vertical-align:-2px;pointer-events:none')} ${p}<small>${a.length}</small></div><div class="wgr">${a.length?a.map(worldCard).join(''):'<div class="ep2">— 暂无 —</div>'}</div>`});
 return h;
};
B.world=()=>{
 $('#n1')&&($('#n1').onclick=()=>edit('world',null,{pg:'构思中'}));
 $('#wpg')&&($('#wpg').onchange=e=>{const w=W().find(x=>x.id===wopen);if(w){w.pg=e.target.value;save()}});
};
/* char */
Z.char=l=>{
 const tabs=[...CHS,...(l.some(e=>!e.ch)?['未分配']:[])];if(!tabs.includes(ctab))ctab=tabs[0];
 const mine=l.filter(e=>ctab==='未分配'?!e.ch:e.ch===ctab),es=byDate(mine.filter(wfil)),k='ch_'+ctab;
 let h=`<div class="tabs">${tabs.map(c=>`<button class="tab ${c===ctab?'on':''}" data-tab="${c}">${c}</button>`).join('')}</div>`;
 h+=`<div class="chhead"><div class="chav" data-ph="${k}" title="点击更换照片">${DB._ph[k]?`<img src="${DB._ph[k]}">`:cam('','font-size:44px;pointer-events:none')}</div><div><div class="chn">${ctab}</div><div class="chintro" contenteditable="true" role="textbox" aria-label="角色简介" data-chintro="${esc(ctab)}">${esc((DB._chintro||{})[ctab]||'')}</div><small>在 ${new Set(mine.map(e=>String(e.wid||''))).size} 个世界观里 · 共 ${mine.length} 条设定 · 点头像换照片</small></div></div>`;
 h+=toolsH(`<button class="btn" id="n1">＋ 新增${ctab==='未分配'?'':ctab}的设定</button>`,1);
 if(!es.length)return h+empty();
 return h+byWorld(es).map(([k2,a])=>`<div class="pgh">${esc(wlabel(k2))}<small>${a.length}</small></div><div class="chl">${a.map(e=>`<div class="chc" ${dat(e,'char')}>${e.img?`<img src="${e.img}">`:''}<div><b>${esc(e.t)||'设定'}</b>${e.role||e.age?`<span class="tag">${esc([e.role,e.age].filter(Boolean).join(' · '))}</span>`:''}<p><u>设定</u>${esc(e.b)}</p>${e.exp?`<p><u>经历</u>${esc(e.exp)}</p>`:''}</div></div>`).join('')}</div>`).join('');
};
B.char=()=>{$('#n1').onclick=()=>edit('char',null,{ch:ctab==='未分配'?CHS[0]:ctab,wid:rwf()})};
document.addEventListener('focusout',e=>{const el=e.target.closest('[data-chintro]');if(!el)return;DB._chintro=DB._chintro||{};DB._chintro[el.dataset.chintro]=el.innerText.trim().slice(0,1500);save()});
/* lore */
Z.lore=l=>{
 const es=byDate(l.filter(wfil));
 const h=toolsH('<button class="btn" id="n1">＋ 新建设定</button>',1)+chipsH(catsOf(l));
 if(!es.length)return h+empty();
 return h+byWorld(es).map(([k,a])=>`<details class="fd" open><summary>${cam('','font-size:16px;vertical-align:-2px;pointer-events:none')} ${esc(wlabel(k))}<small>${a.length}</small></summary>${a.map(e=>itemHTML(e,'lore')).join('')}</details>`).join('');
};
B.lore=()=>{$('#n1').onclick=()=>edit('lore',null,{wid:rwf()})};
/* draft */
Z.draft=l=>{
 const es=byDate(l.filter(wfil));
 const h=toolsH('<button class="btn" id="n1">＋ 新建文稿</button>',1)+chipsH(DCATS);
 if(!es.length)return h+empty();
 return h+`<div class="note" style="text-align:left;margin:0 0 10px">共 ${es.length} 篇 · ${es.reduce((n,e)=>n+cnt(e.b),0)} 字</div>`+es.map(e=>`<div class="item" ${dat(e,'draft')}><div style="flex:1"><b>${esc(e.t)||'（无题）'}</b><span class="tag">${esc(e.c||'正文')}</span>${e.wid?`<span class="tag">${esc(wlabel(String(e.wid)))}</span>`:''}<small>${esc(e.d)} · ${cnt(e.b)} 字${e.vs&&e.vs.length?' · '+e.vs.length+' 个快照':''}</small><p>${esc((e.b||'').slice(0,120))}</p></div><button class="btn o" data-edr="${e.id}">编辑</button></div>`).join('');
};
B.draft=()=>{$('#n1').onclick=()=>editDoc(null,{wid:rwf()})};
/* fav */
Z.fav=l=>{
 const h=toolsH('<button class="btn" id="fi">＋ 添加图片</button><button class="btn o" id="n1">＋ 新建收藏</button><input type="file" id="fif" accept="image/*" multiple hidden>')+chipsH(catsOf(l));
 if(!l.length)return h+empty();
 return h+`<div class="fm">${byDate(l).map(e=>{const inner=(e.c?`<small>${esc(e.c)}</small>`:'')+(e.t?`<h3>${esc(e.t)}</h3>`:'')+(e.star?`<div class="stars">${esc(e.star)}</div>`:'')+(e.b?`<p>${esc(e.b)}</p>`:'')+(e.url?`<a href="${esc(safeUrl(e.url))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">打开 ↗</a>`:'');return `<div class="fc" ${dat(e,'fav')}>${e.img?`<img src="${e.img}">`:''}${inner?`<div class="cb">${inner}</div>`:''}</div>`}).join('')}</div>`;
};
B.fav=()=>{
 $('#n1').onclick=()=>edit('fav');
 $('#fi').onclick=()=>$('#fif').click();
 $('#fif').onchange=ev=>{const fs=[...ev.target.files];if(!fs.length)return;let n=0;fs.forEach((f,i)=>shrink(f,900,u=>{DB.fav.push({id:Date.now()+i,t:'',c:'',b:'',d:today(),img:u,url:'',star:''});if(++n===fs.length){save();render()}}))};
};
/* tarot */
Z.tarot=l=>{
 const h=toolsH('<button class="btn" id="dq">抽牌提问</button><button class="btn o" id="ch">＋ 传讯对话</button>')+chipsH(['抽牌提问','传讯对话']);
 if(!l.length)return h+empty();
 return h+byDate(l).map(e=>`<div class="item" ${dat(e,'tarot',e.sp)}>${cam('','font-size:34px;pointer-events:none')}<div style="flex:1"><b>${esc(e.t)||'（无题）'}</b><span class="tag">${esc(e.sp||'抽牌提问')}</span><small>${esc(e.d)}</small>${e.qu?`<p><u>问</u>${esc(e.qu)}</p>`:''}<p>${esc(e.b)}</p></div></div>`).join('');
};
B.tarot=()=>{$('#dq').onclick=askDraw;$('#ch').onclick=()=>edit('tarot',null,{sp:'传讯对话'})};
/* idea */
Z.idea=l=>'<div class="tools"><input id="qi" placeholder="记下一个念头，回车贴上便签…"></div>'+toolsH('<button class="btn" id="n1">＋ 新建便签</button>')+chipsH(catsOf(l))+boardHTML('idea');
B.idea=()=>{
 $('#n1').onclick=()=>edit('idea');bindBoard('idea');
 $('#qi').onkeydown=e=>{const v=e.target.value.trim();if(e.key==='Enter'&&v){const n={id:Date.now(),t:v.split('\n')[0].slice(0,16),c:'',b:v.length>16?v:'',d:today(),img:'',col:''};DB.idea.push(n);lastNew=n.id;save();render()}};
};
/* time */
Z.time=l=>{
 const tls=DB._tls,vis=tls.filter(t=>wfil(t));
 if(!vis.some(t=>t.id===tlsel))tlsel=vis.length?vis[0].id:null;
 const ct=tls.find(t=>t.id===tlsel);
 const tid=e=>e.tl&&tls.some(t=>t.id===e.tl)?e.tl:tls[0].id;
 let h=`<div class="tabs">${vis.map(t=>`<button class="tab ${t.id===tlsel?'on':''}" data-tl="${t.id}">${esc(t.n)}${t.wid?`<small style="opacity:.7"> · ${esc(wlabel(String(t.wid)))}</small>`:''}</button>`).join('')}<button class="tab add" id="tadd">＋ 新建时间线</button></div>`;
 h+=toolsH(ct?'<button class="btn" id="n1">＋ 新建事件</button><button class="btn o" id="tren">编辑时间线</button><button class="btn o" id="tdel">删除此时间线</button>':'',1);
 if(!ct)return h+empty()+'<div class="note">这个世界观下还没有时间线，点「＋ 新建时间线」</div>';
 h+=`<div class="note" style="text-align:left;margin:0 0 8px">所属世界观：${esc(wlabel(String(ct.wid||'')).replace('未关联世界观','其他（未关联）'))}</div>`;
 const es=l.filter(e=>tid(e)===tlsel);
 if(!es.length)return h+empty();
 const ok=e=>e.ord!==''&&e.ord!=null&&!isNaN(+e.ord);
 const a=[...es].sort((x,y)=>ok(x)&&ok(y)?x.ord-y.ord:ok(x)?-1:ok(y)?1:(x.d||'').localeCompare(y.d||''));
 return h+`<div class="tv">${a.map((e,i)=>`<div class="te ${i%2?'r':''}" ${dat(e,'time')}>${cam('nd','pointer-events:none')}<div><small>${esc(e.when||e.d)}</small><h3>${esc(e.t)||'（无题）'}</h3>${e.c?`<span class="tag" style="margin:0">${esc(e.c)}</span>`:''}<p>${esc(e.b)}</p></div></div>`).join('')}</div>`;
};
function tlEdit(id,pre){
 const t=DB._tls.find(x=>
